item.title: It’s Cuffing Season in Dublin Whether You Like it or Not
item.description: The phenomenon is predictable just as are the seasons. item.title: Motaz Azaiza Receives Law Soc’s Praeses Elit Award
item.description: On February 5th, Dublin University Law Society (Law Soc) presented the Praeses Elit Award to Gazan photojournalist Motaz Azaiza in collaboration with Trinity Boycott, Divestment & Sanctions (BDS). On Instagram, Law Soc highlighted his “courageous and uncompromising photojournalism”, noting that “his images have documented not only devastation, but also resilience, dignity, and the enduring humanity of the people whose stories he tells”. item.title: Stoned To Death: Creativity, Collaborations and Pint Claddaghs
item.description: Bevin (Bev) Armstrong’s journey as a jeweller and creative started just over two years ago, as a form of art therapy. Since then, Armstrong has moved to London and Stoned To Death has evolved into a brand focused on creating gender-affirming jewellery with an Irish flair. In their studio, Bev does it all, from jewellery making to tattooing to print design. item.title: Erika Kirk to Recruit Students for New TPUSA Brand in Northern Ireland
item.description: Erika Kirk, CEO of right-wing think tank Turning Point USA (TPUSA) and the widow of American political commentator Charlie Kirk, is expected to visit Northern Ireland on a tour to recruit young people to the organisation. According to the Belfast Telegraph, ex-DUP MP Ian Paisley Jr is backing a plan to launch a branch of TPUSA in Northern Ireland.
